images.scene: Robinson steps aboard the anchored ship off his island, carrying his relics: the great goat-skin cap on his head, his umbrella under one arm, and a parrot perched nearby, taking a last look back at the shore.
images.alt: A bearded man in goatskin clothes boards a ship, carrying an umbrella and a parrot, looking back at an island.

images.scene: Two desperate men swim through the sea to the side of the tall sailing ship at dawn, reaching up with pleading arms toward sailors who look down over the rail.
images.alt: Two men swim to a ship's side at dawn, reaching up and begging the crew above.

images.scene: Inside a Lisbon room, Robinson clasps hands with the frail old Portuguese sea-captain who first rescued him years ago, both men recognising each other with emotion.
images.alt: Two men clasp hands in an old room, recognising each other after many years.

images.scene: The old captain draws a worn leather pouch and pours gold moidore coins into Robinson's open hands across a wooden table, alongside a folded ship's title deed.
images.alt: An old man pours gold coins from a pouch into another man's hands over a table.

images.scene: Friday stands on a mountain road staring up in fear and wonder at the Pyrenees peaks blanketed in deep snow, shivering, having never seen snow before.
images.alt: A man on a road looks up in fear at snow-covered mountains.

images.scene: On a snowy mountain trail near a dark wood, Friday rides up close and fires his pistol point-blank into a wolf attacking the fallen guide, while other wolves and a bear lurk at the wood's edge.
images.alt: A man on horseback shoots a wolf attacking a fallen guide on a snowy trail near woods.
